$comment: Ceilings for the published WASM web bundle, enforced by scripts/check-wasm-size.js.
0.16 intentionally retains Rust schema validation and all renderer capabilities
while adding the shared resident document/evaluator and journal/history runtime.
The maintainer explicitly accepted a larger binary rather than moving validation
to JavaScript or pursuing a broader Formualizer dependency reduction in this release.
Initial resident web artifact: raw 10355187, Brotli 2510016 bytes; wasm-release,
Rust 1.93.0, Binaryen 123 -Oz. Ceilings are that measurement plus 10 percent,
rounded up. Final registry-only Umya 3 artifact: raw 10668574, Brotli 2602922 bytes,
within the same ceilings. Prior ceilings were 9434281 raw / 2265295 Brotli.
The guard remains enforced. Future increases require an explicit justification.
